features.label: 3 Point Correction Principle
features.text: The anatomically contoured postural splint corrects hallux valgus according to the 3-point principle

features.label: Continuously Adjustable Fastening
features.text: Set the correction pressure to the level you need using a soft strap

features.label: Low Fatigue Cushioning
features.text: Padding protects against pressure points to increase wearing comfort

features.label: Stretches Shortened Soft Tissue
features.text: The splint gently stretches shortened parts of the capsule and soft tissue

features.label: Designed for Rest and Night
features.text: Made for wear while resting to immobilize the big toe

features.label: Conservative and Post-Op Care
features.text: Supports conservative pre-operative and post-operative treatment of hallux valgus

features.label: Lightweight German Made Build
features.text: Crafted in Germany with high quality materials for lasting support

indications: Conservative pre-operative treatment of hallux valgus
measurement: Size 1: Fits women 5 to 6 and men 3.5 to 4.5 Size 2: Fits women 6.5 to 9 and men 5 to 7.5 Size 3: Fits women 9.5 to 14 and men 8 to 12
